dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you like it here?

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: Hmm. If you ask me, it would be a nice place to settle down in.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: This realm isn't as cool as the snowy mountains, but I don't need to worry about being scorched by the sun or sudden temperature changes.

dialogues.speaker: Chongyun
dialogues.text: I can concentrate on training since there's no need to worry about the effects of my yang energy.

choices.text: Not going to go outside and walk around?

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If I do, I have to carry a parasol around and keep an eye on the sun.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Anyway, thank you for inviting me to such a cozy place...

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: If you need anything from me, I'll help out.

choices.text: Looks like I won't have to worry about evil spirits in here.

response.speaker: Chongyun
response.text: Naturally. I can assure you of that.
